question: Choose the correctly spelled name of a CSF-shunt procedure.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The correctly spelled medical term is 'Ventriculoperitoneal'.**

 
• A **Ventriculoperitoneal (VP) shunt** is a medical procedure used to treat excess cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) in the brain, commonly due to hydrocephalus. **(मस्तिष्क में तरल का निकास)**
 
• The term is formed from:
 
 
• **Ventriculo-** → referring to the brain ventricles
 
• **-peritoneal** → referring to the peritoneal cavity (abdomen)
 
 
 
• This spelling is medically standard and widely accepted in neurosurgery.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Ventriculoperitoneal'**.
